facts.fact: The Uganda Bureau of Statistics draws its 2024 counts from NIRA's Mobile Vital Records System, in which 498,439 live births of all ages (51,527 of them under one year, against 1,515,437 expected births, 3.4%) and 22,182 deaths (8,921 within a year of occurrence, 3.9% of expected) were registered in 2024.

The report describes the Mobile Vital Records System as the system used by the National Identification and Registration Authority, which registers births and deaths under the Registration of Persons Act 2015 on notifications created by the Ministry of Health.

The bureau attributes the 2022 peak in birth registration (175,328 under-one births, 10.8% completeness) to support for civil registration under the World Bank's URMCHIP project and UNICEF support to birth registration in 38 focus districts; it names no domestic budget line for the system.

Under-one births registered in the Mobile Vital Records System fell from 108,655 in 2023 to 51,527 in 2024 (completeness 6.6% to 3.4%) and deaths registered within a year from 17,597 to 8,921 (5.9% to 3.9%), on the Uganda Bureau of Statistics' figures.
